business.name: The Detailing Culture
business.about: The Detailing Culture is a premium auto detailing business based in Toronto. We believe detailing isn't a luxury — it's smart maintenance done beautifully. Every vehicle gets the same careful attention, whether it's a Civic or a Cayenne. We use only professional-grade products including CarPro, Koch Chemie, and Bilt-Hamber, chosen specifically for each vehicle's paint system and finish. We're honest about what your car needs — and equally honest about what it doesn't.
business.tone_description: Warm, honest, and confident — like advice from a knowledgeable friend. Never pushy. Never upselling. Direct and helpful, with genuine care for the client's car and budget.
business.differentiator: We don't rush cars to maximize volume. We give every vehicle the time and attention it deserves. We'll tell you when ceramic coating isn't worth it on your lease. We'll tell you when your car doesn't need a full reset. That honesty is what keeps our clients coming back. Our products are professional grade — not what's most expensive, but what's right for your specific vehicle.

pricing.notes: Prices may vary slightly based on vehicle condition. Heavily soiled or neglected vehicles may require additional time and product. Client will always be informed before any adjustment.
pricing.deposit: No deposit required. Payment on completion.
pricing.taxes: Prices do not include applicable taxes.

disqualification_rules.ceramic_on_lease: Always advise against ceramic coating for leased vehicles — it is not a good investment.
disqualification_rules.ceramic_selling_soon: If client is selling the car within 12 months, advise ceramic coating is likely not worth it.
disqualification_rules.new_client_maintenance: New clients cannot book a Maintenance Wash — they must start with a Reset Wash.
